description: Orange block on a hardening spring (k = 12 N/m, k3 = 800 N/m^3, m = 0.20 kg, b = 0.45 1/s); pulled down 13 cm and released; metre stick below.

k3.unit: N/m^3 (hardening: y'' = -(k/m)(y - y_eq) - (k3/m)(y - y_eq)^3 - b y')

camera: Static camera, orthographic projection onto the motion plane (no perspective, no lens distortion, no camera shake). Scale is uniform: metres_per_pixel.
image_coordinates: Image coordinates are continuous: pixel i spans [i, i+1), origin top-left, y down. A mask centroid computed from pixel indices is 0.5 px smaller than these values.
time_note: Frame i has video timestamp i/fps and physics timestamp i/capture_fps; for slow-motion clips the physics time is slow_motion_factor times shorter than the video time. All event times in this file are PHYSICS times.

moving_objects.centroid_note: centroid_px = mean true object-centre over the exposure (what a perfect mask centroid of the motion-blurred object would give); position_px_at_frame_time = true centre at the exact frame timestamp.

reference.note: first band (at endpoint 0) is black; bands alternate every length/10

expected_numeric.note: Vertical position y_down (m, positive downward from the fixed anchor) obeys y'' = g - (k/m)(y - l0) - b y'. Equivalent form with y_eq = l0 + g m/k.
